name: KYC-Refresh-Bot
description: Scans the customer master, picks customers due for KYC re-verification based on risk category, emails document requests and updates the KYC status in the core banking system.

name: STR-Filer-Bot
description: Collects flagged suspicious transactions from the monitoring queue, prepares the suspicious transaction report and submits it to the FIU portal.

name: Sanctions-Screening-Bot
description: Screens customer names against sanctions and watch lists, logs hits for analyst review.

name: Loan-Disbursal-Bot
description: Validates approved loan applications, checks the customer risk category and KYC status, and triggers disbursal to the customer account.

name: FX-Derivative-Booking-Bot
description: Books foreign exchange derivative contracts for customers and handles cancellation, rebooking and rollover on maturity.

name: Hedge-Limit-Checker-Bot
description: Checks customers' open INR forex positions against the threshold allowed without proof of underlying exposure.

name: Hedge-Documentation-Bot
description: Collects customer documents and undertakings at deal confirmation and archives them for audit.

name: KYC-Document-Verification-Bot
description: Verifies identity documents during account opening and accepts overseas-certified copies for non-resident customers.
